config.label: An Untappd access token you already hold
config.description: An Untappd access token you already hold. Supply it and no password is needed (username/password become optional).

config.label: Your Untappd username or login email
config.description: Your Untappd username or login email. Required unless UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

config.label: Your Untappd account password (used only for xauth login)
config.description: Your Untappd account password (used only for xauth login). Required unless UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

config.label: Untappd mobile app client id (obtained by intercepting the app; see README)
config.description: Untappd mobile app client id (obtained by intercepting the app; see README). Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

config.label: Untappd mobile app client secret
config.description: Untappd mobile app client secret. Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

config.label: Stable device UUID the token is keyed to (a default is provided)
config.description: Stable device UUID the token is keyed to (a default is provided).

config.label: Override the User-Agent (default mimics the app)
config.description: Override the User-Agent (default mimics the app).

config.label: IANA timezone (e
config.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) that check-ins are stamped with when the call doesn't pass timezone. Set it when the server runs somewhere other than the drinker's zone (e.g. a hosted connector, usually UTC). Defaults to the server process's zone.

config.label: The directory untappd_checkin's photo_path must be inside (several allowed, separated by :)
config.description: The directory untappd_checkin's photo_path must be inside (several allowed, separated by :). Defaults to ~/Downloads/untappd-mcp — put a photo there to attach it. Any other file is refused, so a prompt-injected shout or comment can't publish an arbitrary image from your disk.

config.label: Path to the local check-in cache SQLite file (default ~/
config.description: Path to the local check-in cache SQLite file (default ~/.untappd-mcp/checkins.db; created owner-only — dir 0700, file 0600). Local/stdio only.

config.label: Directory for the cache instead of ~/
config.description: Directory for the cache instead of ~/.untappd-mcp (the file is checkins.db inside it). UNTAPPD_CACHE_DB wins if both are set. Local/stdio only.
